title: Self-normalised Bennett inequalities for Hilbert-valued martingales
summary: We prove time-uniform self-normalised Bennett inequalities for a martingale $(M_n)_{n\geq0}$ in a separable Hilbert space, with $M_0=0$ and increments bounded in norm by one. Writing $V_n$ for its predictable covariance process and $h(u)=(1+u)\log(1+u)-u$ for the Bennett rate function, we show that, for every regularisation parameter $ρ>0$, the process \[\exp\left\{ρ\,h\!\left(\frac{\left\lVert (V_n+ρI)^{-1/2}M_n\right\rVert}{\sqrtρ}\right)-\frac12\log\det\left(I+ρ^{-1}V_n\right)\right\},\qquad n\geq0,\] is a nonnegative supermartingale with initial value one, where $\det$ is the Fredholm…
